data.body: MERGED: Gerrit change 1365 submitted; merged as ace61e34bbfe6d2e6072085de28153b5467f3bdf on main (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments). All four AC met and flipped: (1) build_bedrock_provider threads botocore Config(retries={'max_attempts': N, 'mode': 'adaptive'}, read/connect timeout = timeout_s) from the same config values the Anthropic path uses; (2) semantics documented at the set site (bedrock_model.py docstring: botocore max_attempts = total attempts = tenacity stop_after_attempt(N); timeout_s -> both read+connect; llm_retry_max_wait_s unmapped); (3) behavioral spy-session tests assert the constructed client's Config carries the configured values, mutation-verified RED on revert to BedrockProvider(region_name=region); (4) runbook posture section rewritten (plus eb6e alarm description, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/config.md). Residual gap (deliberate, per operator decision): llm_retry_max_wait_s remains Anthropic-only — botocore exposes no max-backoff knob; documented rather than approximated.
